data.narrative:
Kreios Space is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised €8M to date. The sector comp universe includes 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning multiple maturity stages, including SpaceX, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, Impulse Space, and Apex Space.

Traditional valuation triangulation methods encounter material constraints here. Peer-Median benchmarking is not applicable: while 11 same-sector peers exist, zero meet the confluence of same-stage and valuation-tier filters required for a defensible narrow peer set; expanding to all-sector medians introduces unacceptable heterogeneity bias. Public-Comp Anchoring via P/S multiple is similarly inapplicable—the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 23.9x revenue across the six public tickers, but Kreios Space's revenue (if any) is not disclosed, as is standard for early-stage private companies.

The absence of sufficient narrow-set comparables and revenue data means no quantitative valuation range can be derived from the provided inputs. Any valuation recommendation would require either (1) disclosure of Kreios Space's current or projected revenue, (2) identification of earlier-stage private raise data for precedent pricing, or (3) establishment of a robust comparable via investor syndication or Series A fundraising intel. At present, the analysis cannot support a specific valuation thesis.
